title: A second machine for the workshop on Tannery Road
story: We have run the joinery for nine years and we are turning work away because everything queues behind one panel saw. A second machine costs 21,000 GBP installed and would let us take on the kitchen contracts we keep declining. We would hire two apprentices from the estate in the first year, which is the part that matters to us. The workshop has been profitable for the last four years and we can service a loan, but the rates quoted to us would eat the margin the apprentices are supposed to come out of.
reviewerNote: Declined for the zakat badge. The copy states the business is trading and has been profitable for four years, so no category of need is engaged; the apprenticeships are a genuine social good and that is not the question this badge answers. Nothing contested came up. The organizer asked whether a bad year would change the answer and I told them yes, potentially, and to resubmit with accounts if it comes to that rather than assume the door is closed.
